title: Fine ivory plaster for the SMK casts
author: ambientCG / Lennart Demes
credit: Created using Plaster001 from ambientCG.com, licensed under CC0 1.0 Universal.
interpretation: A restrained visualization of fine plaster, matching the material recorded for the SMK casts. The added texture is not measured color or a texture scan of these museum objects.
compression: WebP quality 90; the original source ZIP and extracted maps remain unchanged.

channels.R: Source albedo luminance normalized around 0.5, used for restrained ±8% maximum modulation of the ivory base color
channels.G: Source roughness, used for gentle variation around matte roughness 0.83
channels.B: Fine source displacement with coarse relief removed by a periodic blur subtraction, used as a 0.20 mm bump signal

mapping: Three smoothly blended object-space projections with a 0.28 m repeat; one shared texture and three texture samples per fragment.
fallback: Plain opaque ivory plaster if the map cannot load. No sculpture UVs, geometry, GLB assets or plinth materials are modified.
